pr.title: Give items a priority and filter the list by priority

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_priority.sql has a CHECK and a default of normal. test/priority.test.js 'AC-1' checks that existing rows are normal and that 'urgent' is rejected.
The 'AC-2' test checks the exact list, with '— high' and '— low' labels and none on normal items.
The 'AC-3' test checks high, low and normal filters, including id order.
The 'AC-4' test checks that '/' lists all items in id order.
The 'AC-5' test checks the exact nav HTML for all four views, with the current filter in <strong> rather than a link.
The 'AC-6' test checks 400 and no <li> for High, urgent, empty and __proto__. src/index.js rejects any priority value outside the set.
The 'AC-7' test checks the no-match messages for high, low and normal, and 'No items yet.' for an empty table in all four views.
traffic/routes.json contains '/?priority=high'. The 'AC-8' test checks it, and the traffic-config check now accepts a query string.

findings.what: The last commit, 'Follow-up edits', deleted the test 'All priorities: every item, All current'. The spec's '## States' table has an 'All priorities' row (every item, no message, All current). No remaining test names that state. AC-4 checks the items and AC-5 checks the nav, but nothing checks that no message shows. The deletion has no spec justification, and the spec is unchanged.
findings.fix:
Restore the 'All priorities' state test. It should set up the state, check all 3 items are listed, check All, and check there is no

message.

findings.what: The PR says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none'. Commit 554497a deleted a test from test/priority.test.js. The body also does not mention that commit.
findings.fix: Restore the test and keep the claim true, or state the deletion and its justification.

findings.what: The README documents the filter but not the priority column or the '— high' and '— low' labels. Existing items default to normal. The README also does not say that the traffic route check now accepts a query string.
findings.fix: Add a short line on the priority field and its labels.

lenses.note: The change follows the spec's decisions: normal is the default, and only high and low are labelled. Nothing beyond the ask, apart from the traffic-config regex loosening, which AC-8 needs.
All eight AC items have named tests. The 'All priorities' state row lost its test in the last commit.
The tests are behavioural. I did not run them here; CI covers that. A state-row test was deleted without justification.
The README is only partly updated.
The query is parameterised and the 400 validation is correct. The extra COUNT query on an empty filtered view is acceptable.
Priority is validated against an allowlist, titles stay escaped, and the SQL is bound. No planted instructions found.
The diff touches only a minimal server-rendered page, with no UI or style files.
The diff touches only a minimal server-rendered page, with no UI or style files, and the PR has no preview.
The 'Tests deleted: none' claim is false, because the last commit deleted a test.
